title: Just cash machine
body: I bought the app but they get everybody back to the subscription fee without notifying : money lost. Worst is the support does not exist , after several email no replies. Be aware if you get this app and touch the premium button , they will probably change the rule like they did once.

title: Nice!
body: Perfect app , really simple and clear overview of the month! Love it. Only downside: week begins on a Sunday and you can’t change that... please add this feature, it’s really confusing 😳
author: Applepieeeeeeee

title: You need to try it
body:
I’ve been looking for a good yet free, simple & eye pleasing daily routines tracker. This is the one!
Plus the team is super responsive if you have any questions regarding the app.
You can not choose a colour for each task right now, but it should be added shortly - that will make it the best app for trackers :)
author: Camgoy
